verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.162
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.162

verses.pali: 17. Paṭipadāvagga
verses.english: 17. Practice

verses.pali: Vitthārasutta
verses.english: In Detail

verses.pali: “Catasso imā, bhikkhave, paṭipadā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, there are four ways of practice.

verses.pali: Katamā catasso?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā,
verses.english: Painful practice with slow insight,

verses.pali: dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā,
verses.english: painful practice with swift insight,

verses.pali: sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā,
verses.english: pleasant practice with slow insight, and

verses.pali: sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā.
verses.english: pleasant practice with swift insight.

verses.pali: Katamā ca, bhikkhave, dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā?
verses.english: And what’s the painful practice with slow insight?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pakatiyāpi tibbarāgajātiko hoti, abhikkhaṇaṁ rāgajaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti.
verses.english: It’s when someone is ordinarily full of acute greed, hate, and delusion. They often feel the pain and sadness that greed, hate, and delusion bring.

verses.pali: Pakatiyāpi tibbadosajātiko hoti, abhikkhaṇaṁ dosajaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti.
Pakatiyāpi tibbamohajātiko hoti, abhikkhaṇaṁ mohajaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti.
Tassimāni pañcindriyāni mudūni pātubhavanti—
verses.english: These five faculties manifest in them weakly:

verses.pali: saddhindriyaṁ, vīriyindriyaṁ, satindriyaṁ, samādhindriyaṁ, paññindriyaṁ.
verses.english: faith, energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: So imesaṁ pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ muduttā dandhaṁ ānantariyaṁ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṁ khayāya.
verses.english: Because of this, they only slowly attain the conditions for ending the defilements in the present life.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā.
verses.english: This is called the painful practice with slow insight.

verses.pali: Katamā ca, bhikkhave, dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā?
verses.english: And what’s the painful practice with swift insight?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pakatiyāpi tibbarāgajātiko hoti, abhikkhaṇaṁ rāgajaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti.
verses.english: It’s when someone is ordinarily full of acute greed, hate, and delusion. They often feel the pain and sadness that greed, hate, and delusion bring.

verses.pali: Pakatiyāpi tibbadosajātiko hoti, abhikkhaṇaṁ dosajaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti.
Pakatiyāpi tibbamohajātiko hoti, abhikkhaṇaṁ mohajaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti.
Tassimāni pañcindriyāni adhimattāni pātubhavanti—
verses.english: And these five faculties manifest in them strongly:

verses.pali: saddhindriyaṁ, vīriyindriyaṁ, satindriyaṁ, samādhindriyaṁ, paññindriyaṁ.
verses.english: faith, energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: So imesaṁ pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ adhimattattā khippaṁ ānantariyaṁ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṁ khayāya.
verses.english: Because of this, they swiftly attain the conditions for ending the defilements in the present life.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā.
verses.english: This is called the painful practice with swift insight.

verses.pali: Katamā ca, bhikkhave, sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā?
verses.english: And what’s pleasant practice with slow insight?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pakatiyāpi na tibbarāgajātiko hoti, nābhikkhaṇaṁ rāgajaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti.
verses.english: It’s when someone is not ordinarily full of acute greed, hate, and delusion. They rarely feel the pain and sadness that greed, hate, and delusion bring.

verses.pali: Pakatiyāpi na tibbadosajātiko hoti, nābhikkhaṇaṁ dosajaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti.
Pakatiyāpi na tibbamohajātiko hoti, nābhikkhaṇaṁ mohajaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti.
Tassimāni pañcindriyāni mudūni pātubhavanti—
verses.english: These five faculties manifest in them weakly:

verses.pali: saddhindriyaṁ …pe… paññindriyaṁ.
verses.english: faith, energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: So imesaṁ pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ muduttā dandhaṁ ānantariyaṁ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṁ khayāya.
verses.english: Because of this, they only slowly attain the conditions for ending the defilements in the present life.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā.
verses.english: This is called the pleasant practice with slow insight.

verses.pali: Katamā ca, bhikkhave, sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā?
verses.english: And what’s the pleasant practice with swift insight?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pakatiyāpi na tibbarāgajātiko hoti, nābhikkhaṇaṁ rāgajaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti.
verses.english: It’s when someone is not ordinarily full of acute greed, hate, and delusion. They rarely feel the pain and sadness that greed, hate, and delusion bring.

verses.pali: Pakatiyāpi na tibbadosajātiko hoti, nābhikkhaṇaṁ dosajaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti.
Pakatiyāpi na tibbamohajātiko hoti, nābhikkhaṇaṁ mohajaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti.
Tassimāni pañcindriyāni adhimattāni pātubhavanti—
verses.english: These five faculties manifest in them strongly:

verses.pali: saddhindriyaṁ, vīriyindriyaṁ, satindriyaṁ, samādhindriyaṁ, paññindriyaṁ.
verses.english: faith, energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: So imesaṁ pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ adhimattattā khippaṁ ānantariyaṁ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṁ khayāya.
verses.english: Because of this, they swiftly attain the conditions for ending the defilements in the present life.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā.
verses.english: This is called the pleasant practice with swift insight.

verses.pali: Imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso paṭipadā”ti.
verses.english: These are the four ways of practice.”

verses.pali: Dutiyaṁ.
